title: One of Grusch's 40 witnesses died at a convenient time

tellings.quote: one of them is the guy who's no longer with us. Um, whose demise was was quite conveniently timed for those who might have something to do with it.

plain: One of the roughly 40 witnesses behind David Grusch, a whistleblower who says secret programmes hold crashed craft not made by humans, is said to have died at a suspiciously convenient moment. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he flew a UFO out of a recovery site, tells Michels this, saying the man's death was "quite conveniently timed" for whoever might be behind it. If true, it would suggest that witnesses are being silenced.
